summary: The FCC should not condition E-Rate on screen-time limits for children.

claims.requested_action: Do not condition E-Rate on screen-time limits
claims.argument: Screen-time limits are not an appropriate FCC jurisdiction
claims.evidence_quote: I believe the concerns raised in this docket about children screen time is valid, but this is not the remit of the FCC where power is only wielded in broad strokes.
